##### Project general facts

Renad Tower by Tiger Group is an exciting launch, marking the developer's first project in the emirate. This thirty-seven-storey tower on the Gulf Coast combines classical architectural elements with refined luxury, offering a wide range of studio, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom apartments. Each residence is designed in a contemporary style and comes fully furnished, with private balconies featuring panoramic views of the canal and cityscape, promising a luxurious living experience with a breathtaking perspective of nature.

Residents enjoy access to several swimming pools, a gym with the most modern equipment, a children's playground, and a picturesque garden with walking paths, recreation areas, and barbecue zones. The tranquil and well-balanced structure of the complex offers a truly exceptional way of life, where modernism and high standards of living welcome residents among opulent and spacious homes.

Every residence at Renad Tower features premium finishing with high-quality materials, fully equipped kitchens, and contemporary design. Apartments are fully furnished, offering a turnkey living experience. The interiors are crafted to rejuvenate the spirit and soul with spectacular, sumptuous outdoor facilities, enveloping residents in joys and making every day count.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Al Reem Island, a mixed-use, fast-developing area in the northeast of Abu Dhabi, this exceptional location offers the opportunity for a resort lifestyle close to all the amenities of a major metropolis. Most residential buildings are located in close proximity to the sea and beaches, while the island has a well-developed social and entertainment infrastructure with banks, commercial facilities, parks, and sports areas.

The location is distinguished by its strategic connectivity to key destinations. Al Maryah Island, Saadiyat Island, and the Abu Dhabi mainland are just minutes away, while Yas Island, Abu Dhabi International Airport, Warner Bros. World, Yas Waterworld, and Ferrari World are all within easy reach. Within walking distance are kindergartens, schools, cafes, restaurants, The Galleria Al Maryah Island, and Reem Mall.

For those seeking a residence that embodies modern luxury, waterfront living, and a prime Abu Dhabi address, Al Reem Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the emirate's most desirable destinations. This is a place where a new way of life awaits — contemporary, refined and effortlessly connected.
